# `bank-line` commands

## `bank-line query`

The bank inbox: lines by account, state (waiting, matched, settled...), import, dates, words or an exact amount, with counts by state. Example: {"account": "Checking", "state": "waiting"}.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | bank-feed |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/bank-line.query` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow bank-line query --account Checking --state waiting --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "bank-line query", "input": {"account": "Checking", "state": "waiting"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | `--account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `state` | `--state` | literal["waiting", "matched", "added", "transfer", "ignored", "settled"] \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `import_id` | `--import-id` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only lines this import brought in. |
| `date_from` | `--date-from` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `date_to` | `--date-to` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `text` | `--text` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Words in the payee, memo or number. |
| `amount` | `--amount` | string \| null | no | yes | null | An exact amount, bank sign ("-4.50"). |
| `include_reversed` | `--include-reversed` | boolean | no | no | false | — |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 100 | minimum 1; maximum 1000 |
| `cursor` | `--cursor` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/bank-line.query`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
